metadata.description: Skills for software engineering agents: one plugin per technology family, and a delivery process that reads the repository's AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: mulesoft
plugins.description: Mule 4 applications, DataWeave, MUnit and the Mule SDK: rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: REST API specifications in RAML and OpenAPI: resources, data types, errors, examples, versioning and security, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: languages
plugins.description: Java, Python and shell: build and environment, code, tests and portability rules with stable IDs, and checks that run.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions and Jenkins: templates, permissions, secrets, triggers and deploys, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Astro static sites and Cloudflare Workers and Pages: builds, webhooks, secrets, staging and production, as rules with stable IDs.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: A change flow for any code repository: entry and exit checklists, independent review, merge gates by risk and delivery models, driven by lines of the repository's AGENTS.md.
